articles.title: Ratan Tata’s beloved pet dog 'Goa' survives car accident outside Bombay House - The Times of India
articles.full_text:
MUMBAI: Industrialist
Ratan Tata's beloved pet dog Goa was injured in a car accident outside the Tata company's headquarters Bombay House, Fort, Thursday.
The loyal canine was taken inside the building, his favourite space, and given prompt medical attention. Noel Tata visited to check on him.
Goa is to participate in the Blessing of Pets ceremony at Our Lady of Health Church in Cavel, Kalbadevi, on Sunday October 11.
By evening, fortunately, he was doing well except for a few howls when his injured paw was touched.
"He is on the road to recovery and is looking forward to be showstopper at Sunday's ceremony," said parish priest Fr Joseph D'Souza.
Ratan Tata's second death anniversary falls October 9.
